name: 85701 · Tucson, AZ
findings: ZIP 85701 (Tucson) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85701 (Tucson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85701 (Tucson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
